name: screenshot-battle-status-escape

dynamicWidthEvidence.limitation: Exact static-table maxima were measured from all 247 published enemy translations and the dictionary-expanded original enemy table. They are not proof of every runtime 09 producer, customizable party name, suffix or numeric bound. Width tests use name 6 + suffix 2 + 的 1 + stat 3 = 12; the original-table name maximum 8 also fits at 14. Quantity tests additionally allow five digits (65535), fitting at ten glyphs, without asserting a runtime 16-bit bound.

validationNotes: Only the two untranslated screenshot-related records are selected from the 181-record uncompressed block. No ROM, patch, target allocation or deployment is produced.
compileTextDraft does not support sourceType 0. Source SHA, indexed offsets, original bytes and ordered controls are checked directly; future integration must retain every dynamic 09 and quantity 0a.

For the 14-glyph check, consecutive 09 markers budget six glyphs for a name and two for its suffix; the third 09 budgets three for the stat label. These dynamic allocations are assumptions, not native-runtime verification.
Screenshot 18 is already translated at 0x7004b:48 and is not duplicated here. Screenshot 90 cannot distinguish this generic stat message from already-translated attack-drop record 0x7004b:86.
